subject: MAP: Security gate timeline & data residency questions (FinBridge)
body:
--- Message 1/4 ---
From: Sabrina Lowe <sabrina.lowe@finbridge.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@finbridge.com, FinBridge Security <security@finbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Nov 2028 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: MAP kickoff — SOC 2, DPA carveouts, and retention (FinBridge)

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week — the team was impressed with the latency and routing controls. Procurement asked me to get a MAP and an initial timeline in place so we can coordinate our compliance review with InfoSec. A few items we need to lock down in the MAP before legal/procurement will move forward: 

- SOC 2 attestation: we need the latest report and an outline of the remediation plan (if any) for open controls.
- SIG/CAIQ responses: our security team will run a light SIG review and will ask follow-ups.
- DPA scope: can you confirm which data classes are covered (PII vs. non-PII), and whether Redwood supports EU residency for tokens/logs?
- Data retention: we need firm retention windows for logs, KV cache snapshots, and model telemetry. If there's an archival/escrow option, please call that out.

Target: FinBridge wants a formal MAP and expected 'close-ready' date so we can align our procurement sprint next month. Can you propose a 3-week plan that includes evidence delivery points?

Attachments: none in this message.

Best,
Sabrina Lowe
Senior Procurement Manager
FinBridge

--- Message 2/4 ---
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sabrina Lowe <sabrina.lowe@finbridge.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, FinBridge Security <security@finbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — SOC 2, DPA carveouts, and retention (FinBridge)

Hi Sabrina —

Appreciate the clear list. We can absolutely put together a condensed MAP that maps security deliverables to dates/evidence. High-level proposal (3-week track) below: 

Week 1 (Nov 27–Dec 3): Intake & evidence handoff
- Deliver SOC 2 Type II attestation (latest) and controls narrative (pdf) — deliverable: SOC2_Attestation_2028.pdf
- Provide initial SIG/CAIQ partial responses (core controls) and a questionnaire template for your team to prioritize
- Draft DPA excerpt showing data classes (PII/non-PII) and our standard residency/processing locations

Week 2 (Dec 4–Dec 10): Deep-dive & remediation notes
- Live session with your InfoSec (45 min) to walk SIG highlights and open items
- Provide code/architecture diagram for token handling + KV cache eviction policy
- Clarify retention windows for request logs (90 days default, option for 30/365), KV cache (ephemeral: per-session or up to 24h), and telemetry (30 days)

Week 3 (Dec 11–Dec 17): Final evidence & close readiness
- Provide finalized MAP spreadsheet with evidence links and owners (attached)
- Offer contract DPA redline and optional EU residency addendum for logs (if you require on-shore retention)
- Final close readiness call with procurement/legal to confirm go/no-go

Quick answers to your TL;DR asks:
- SOC 2: we have a current Type II (period ended 2028-09-30).
- SIG/CAIQ: partial responses ready; we will prioritize high-risk controls first.
- DPA/data classes: our DPA covers customer-supplied data and derived metadata; we can add annex for stricter residency for logs (extra cost/ops).
- Retention: configurable per-customer; default windows above, can be shortened or extended via contract.

I attached the MAP template and our SOC2 attestation to this message for your intake. Let us know a couple of times that work for the InfoSec deep-dive.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Attachments: FinBridge_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOC2_Attestation_2028.pdf

--- Message 3/4 ---
From: Sabrina Lowe <sabrina.lowe@finbridge.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinBridge Security <security@finbridge.com>, procurement@finbridge.com
Date: Thu, 30 Nov 2028 08:36:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — SOC 2, DPA carveouts, and retention (FinBridge)

Thanks Hannah — this looks good and much appreciated. A few clarifying points from security/procurement after a quick skim: 

- SOC 2: can you confirm whether there are any open exceptions in the latest audit? If yes, provide remediation ETA for each.
- SIG follow-up: security wants the full CAIQ; prioritizing the controls listed in section A and C (authn/authz, data protection, and logging).
- Retention: FinBridge's policy requires a 90-day max for request logs by default, but some regulated products require 30 days. We will need the ability to set per-product retention windows.
- EU residency: we likely need logs ingested and stored in eu-west-1 for our EU customers. Is there an operational SLA and cost delta for this addendum?

Also: procurement asks that the MAP include clear owners and expected deliverable formats (PDF, architecture diagram, SIG answer sheet). Can you mark owners in the spreadsheet and include target delivery dates?

Sabrina

--- Message 4/4 ---
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sabrina Lowe <sabrina.lowe@finbridge.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, FinBridge Security <security@finbridge.com>, procurement@finbridge.com
Date: Fri, 30 Nov 2028 11:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — SOC 2, DPA carveouts, and retention (FinBridge)

Sabrina —

Thanks for the notes. Quick responses inline and next steps below.

- SOC 2: there are two minor exceptions noted on page 7 (change control documentation for a deprecated internal tool). Remediation plan attached with owner + ETA (Markus is owning; estimated remediation complete by 2029-01-15).

- SIG/CAIQ: attaching the full CAIQ export and our prioritized control list — we will complete prioritized answers within 5 business days after the InfoSec deep-dive.

- Retention: Redwood supports per-product retention windows. We will document the config options in the MAP and add a short runbook for setting retention at the tenant/product level.

- EU residency: we can provide logs residency in eu-west-1. Operational SLA for residency addendum: 99.9% availability for log ingestion and a 30-day RPO for cross-region replication to EU (cost delta will be included in the addendum; preliminary estimate attached).

Next steps (I updated the attached MAP spreadsheet with owners and tentative dates):
1) Confirm InfoSec deep-dive slot — propose Tue Dec 5, 10:00 AM PT (45 min).
2) Review attached MAP (FinBridge_MAP_v1.xlsx) and flag any missing owners/formats.
3) We deliver prioritized SIG answers and the DPA addendum draft by Dec 10.

If that timeline works I'll route the DPA addendum and cost estimate to procurement for initial review.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: FinBridge_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP spreadsheet with owners/dates), SOC2_Attestation_2028.pdf (attestation), CAIQ_full_export.csv (SIG answers), Redwood_EU_Addendum_Pricing.pdf (prelim cost delta)
preview: Hannah (Redwood) and FinBridge procurement/security coordinate a 3-week MAP for SOC2, SIG/CAIQ, DPA scope and per-product retention, with attachments and owners assigned.
